title: DashboardLoadingState is shared between the app dashboard and the exporter (shared dashboards)
answers: how to change dashboard loading placeholder cards
body:
The dashboard loading skeleton lives in products/dashboards/frontend/components/DashboardLoadingState/DashboardLoadingState.tsx and is reused by the exporter.
- frontend/src/exporter/Exporter.tsx renders `<DashboardLoadingState showControls={false} tileCount={dashboard.tiles?.length ?? 0} />` as the Suspense fallback for LazyDashboardScene.
- Props: `showControls` (default true) and `tileCount` (default 8) keep the regular dashboard behaviour unchanged.
- Test hooks are `data-attr="dashboard-loading-controls"` and `data-attr="dashboard-loading-tile"`; the test is in frontend/src/exporter/Exporter.test.tsx.
- Changing the skeleton's markup or props affects both the in-app dashboard and shared/exported views, so check both call sites.
applies: Dashboard loading skeleton and shared/exported dashboard views in the exporter.
